title: MATLAB System
text: Include System object in model, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {New} sets Create a System object from a template; {System Object Name} sets the name of the System object, {Simulate using} selects the simulation mode, {Dependency}, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the whether overflows saturate, {Treat these inherited Simulink signal types as fi objects} sets the fi data and {MATLAB System fimath} sets the fixed-point settings to use Same. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: Signal input to a MATLAB System block scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Signal output of a MATLAB System block scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: System Object Name
params.values: Name of the System object cell array (default)

params.name: New
params.values: Create a System object from a template Basic (default) | Advanced | Simulink Extension

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Select the simulation mode Code generation (default) | Interpreted Execution

params.name: Dependency
params.values: Dependency parameter for MATLAB System block auto (default)

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Specify whether overflows saturate Off (default) | On

params.name: Treat these inherited Simulink signal types as fi objects
params.values: Specify fi data types Fixed-point (default) | Fixed-point & Integer

params.name: MATLAB System fimath
params.values: Specify fixed-point settings to use Same as MATLAB (default) | Specify Other
